description: The bar chart compares the accuracy of two models, MMAU and MMAR, across three different datasets: Qwen2-Audio-Instruct, Audio-Reasoner, and Qwen-2.5-Omni. The vertical axis represents accuracy in percentage, ranging from 0 to 70, while the horizontal axis lists the datasets. For each dataset, there are two bars representing the accuracy of MMAU and MMAR, respectively. In the Qwen2-Audio-Instruct dataset, MMAU has an accuracy of approximately 50%, while MMAR is around 30%. In the Audio-Reasoner dataset, MMAU shows a higher accuracy, close to 60%, compared to MMAR, which is around 40%. Lastly, in the Qwen-2.5-Omni dataset, both models have similar accuracy, with MMAU slightly higher than MMAR, both around 60%. The bars are color-coded, with MMAU in blue and MMAR in purple. The chart does not indicate any sorting or emphasis on specific bars.
